packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the CDM process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: Stakeholder
classes.definition: An abstract party that takes part in the CDM process and originates or receives its information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifying name of the stakeholder.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role this stakeholder plays in the CDM process.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline responsible for a flight, who submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides/confirms TOBT and turn-round information.

operations.name: submitATCFlightPlan
operations.description: Submits the ICAO ATC Flight Plan for the flight; correct information must be provided before the first E-DPI, feeding SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data (M1).

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: Provides or updates the Target Off-Block Time, including the most accurate final TOBT t minutes before EOBT, integrating the AO's own strategy (M4-9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling party that, with the Aircraft Operator, manages the turn-round and provides TOBT and ground status updates.

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: Provides or updates TOBT taking into account the operational situation (M4-9).

operations.name: reportGroundHandlingStatus
operations.description: Reports the commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT) and aircraft readiness (ARDT) (M8, M12).

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The ATC unit(s), including Tower, Approach Control and Area Control Centre, that issue TSAT, approve start-up and manage the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: Issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time t minutes before EOBT, a local parameter (M10).

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: Grants start-up approval/push-back clearance following the pilot's request; if not granted by TSAT+tolerance, partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced (M14).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management party that issues CTOT for regulated flights, distributes flight plan information and receives DPI/FUM messages.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: Issues the CTOT to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome at EOBT-2hr for regulated flights, which take priority over unregulated flights (M2).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of a flight within 3hrs flying time of destination using ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message (M3).

classes.name: Aircrew
classes.definition: The flight crew who coordinate with the Ground Handler during turn-round and request start-up from ATC.

operations.name: requestStartUp
operations.description: Requests start up (voice or DCL) just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler (M12, M14).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single flight leg (arrival or departure) tracked through the CDM process from flight plan activation to take-off.

attributes.name: flightNumber
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Registration of the aircraft, fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI (M1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft; the flight plan may be used to update this (M1).

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO departure aerodrome (ADEP).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO destination aerodrome.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether this leg is an arrival or a departure.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, changed by each milestone.

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; fields are marked REGULATED at EOBT-2hr (M2).

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: The Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, used with ATOT to calculate ELDT (M3).

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time, calculated by the ATC system based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and holding-position wait (M9).

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated taxi-in time, used with ELDT/ALDT to compute EIBT (M4, M6).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round linking an arriving flight and a departing flight of the same aircraft.

attributes.name: turnRoundPeriod
attributes.description: The defined/estimated turn-round period used to calculate TOBT/TTOT for the departing flight (M6, M7, M8).

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum Turn-round Time, used in the TTOT calculation basis EIBT+MTTT+EXOT (M2, M3).

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC Flight Plan submitted for a flight and distributed by IFPS to involved ATC units.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: The Scheduled Off-Block Time carried on the flight plan, fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI (M1).

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (M1).

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: The first destination data fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI (M1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The slot time held for the flight.

attributes.name: isCoordinated
attributes.description: Whether the airport is coordinated, determining whether the outbound flight is already known at flight plan activation (M1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: An abstract named time quantity (prefix and event) describing a flight's progress; every successive value is kept with its originator and time of update rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date/time value of this time quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The stakeholder or system that provided or updated this value.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy or tolerance for this quantity, as given in the document (e.g. +/-1 minute).

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: The time this particular value was recorded; an update appends a new value rather than overwriting the previous one.

classes.name: EOBT
classes.definition: Estimated Off-Block Time, the reference point from which several milestones are timed (e.g. EOBT-3hr, EOBT-2hr).

classes.name: SOBT
classes.definition: Scheduled Off-Block Time carried on the flight plan and fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI.

classes.name: TOBT
classes.definition: Target Off-Block Time provided and updated by the AO/GH; a final confirmed TOBT is given t minutes before EOBT and is the basis for TSAT.

classes.name: AOBT
classes.definition: Actual Off-Block Time, the time the aircraft pushes back or vacates the parking position, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ELDT
classes.definition: Estimated Landing Time, updated via FUM, radar detection and ALDT; its accuracy is particularly important at Local Radar Update.

classes.name: EIBT
classes.definition: Estimated In-Block Time, computed using ELDT+EXIT or ALDT+EXIT.

classes.name: ALDT
classes.definition: Actual Landing Time, the time an aircraft touches down, equivalent to ATC ATA, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: AIBT
classes.definition: Actual In-Block Time, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks; ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ETOT
classes.definition: Estimated Take-Off Time, updated for a departure at Flight Plan Activation and at EOBT-2hr.

classes.name: TTOT
classes.definition: Target/calculated Take-Off Time, calculated from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT, monitored against a tolerance before Network Operations is informed.

classes.name: CTOT
classes.definition: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2hr for regulated flights.

classes.name: ATOT
classes.definition: Actual Take-Off Time, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ASBT
classes.definition: Actual Start Boarding Time, when the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ARDT
classes.definition: Actual Ready Time, when doors are closed, boarding bridge removed and the aircraft is ready to taxi, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ASRT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Request Time, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ASAT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Approval Time, the time an aircraft receives its start up approval, accuracy +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ACGT
classes.definition: Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, accuracy +/-1 minute; considered to commence at AIBT for a normal turn-round.

classes.name: TSAT
classes.definition: Target Start-Up Approval Time, issued by ATC t minutes before EOBT.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: The common behaviour of a CDM milestone process: checking TOBT consistency against the ATC Flight Plan and informing Network Operations when TTOT changes beyond the agreed tolerance.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The milestone number (1-16).

attributes.name: triggerDescription
attributes.description: The event or condition that triggers this milestone process.

attributes.name: operationalStatusChange
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone, where stated.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT (M4-9).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsOnTTOTChange
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance, which is respected before informing (M2-9, M15).

classes.name: FlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent; triggered by first activation (earliest EOBT-3hr) or new/late/revised submissions.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: sendFirstEDPI
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data; should not be sent if information is missing or inconsistent.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2Hours
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr most flights are known and all regulated flights receive a CTOT.

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility of EOBT at EOBT-2hrs, triggered by a time stamp at EOBT-2h.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT taking into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is manually input it overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: sendTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations of the updated take-off time estimate via the first T-DPI message at EOBT-2hrs.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP).

operations.name: checkFeasibility
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before informing Network Operations.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT; if EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT=EOBT+EXOT; if TOBT is available it overrules the EIBT+MTTT estimate, so TTOT=TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations of updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t Message, triggered by take off from outstation.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: Calculates ELDT using ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL, when the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport, detected by radar based on assigned SSR code.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: Computes EIBT using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

operations.name: triggerTOBTUpdate
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process: update of ELDT triggers a new TOBT to be entered by AO/GH or calculated automatically; any change to stand/gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, usually 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: updateELDTAndTOBT
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process on update of ELDT, prompting partners to start moving resources such as parking marshal and ground handling services.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down on the runway.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: Updates EIBT according to ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: calculateTOBTAndTTOT
operations.description: Triggers update of TOBT and TTOT, automatically or manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks; ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT.

operations.name: calculateTOBTAndTTOT
operations.description: Triggers update of TOBT and TTOT, automatically or manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: ACGT, the commencement of ground handling operations, specific to first-of-day or long-term parked flights.

operations.name: calculateTOBT
operations.description: Triggers update of TOBT, automatically or manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTOBT
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time the AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT, taking into account the operational situation.

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: Confirms TOBT prior to TSAT issue at a predefined local time [EOBT-t minutes]; triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update, with no need to confirm an existing TOBT manually modified before.

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: The ATC system calculates the Estimated Taxi-Out Time based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and waiting period at the Holding Position.

operations.name: introduceToPreDepartureSequence
operations.description: Introduces the flight into the pre-departure sequence following receipt of TOBT.

classes.name: TSATIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight, stabilising it into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: sendTDPIs
operations.description: Informs Network Operations with a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT issue exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, TOBT input is processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT (e.g. per aircraft type), checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs AO/GH if TOBT needs updating.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: ARDT, when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi upon TWR instructions.

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT or Ready Status (RDY), confirming the flight follows the indicated TOBT, triggered by an input to the Airport CDM Platform.

operations.name: checkReadyStatus
operations.description: At TOBT+tolerance, checks whether ARDT/RDY has been received and informs AO/GH that TOBT has passed without a ready status message.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: ASRT, the time that start up is requested, based on pilot request.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASRT when it occurs.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestTimeliness
operations.description: Alerts partners when no start-up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window; if not requested by TSAT+tolerance, AO/GH is informed to update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start up approval.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ASAT when it occurs, that the aircraft has received start-up/push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start-up approval is not granted by TSAT+tolerance, partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back or vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT when it occurs, that push-back/taxi from parking has commenced.

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in case of remote holding, at a defined time prior to TTOT.

operations.name: checkTTOTChange
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed with a new A-DPI of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS/Radar detection or ACARS.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: Generates an airborne message and removes the flight from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFSAAndMVT
operations.description: Sends FSA and MVT messages.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The central Airport CDM Platform, initiated for a flight, that processes available information and performs the ACISP action recorded at each milestone.

operations.name: processFlightInformation
operations.description: Is initiated for the flight and processes all available information (M1).

operations.name: updateOperationalStatus
operations.description: Updates the flight's operational status as recorded in the 'Operational Status (changes to)' field of each milestone.

operations.name: updateTimeQuantity
operations.description: Appends a new value for a time quantity (e.g. ELDT, EIBT, TOBT, TTOT, AOBT, ATOT) as recorded under each milestone's Action on CDM Operation; every successive value is kept rather than overwritten.

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields of the flight as REGULATED when a CTOT is issued at EOBT-2hr (M2).

operations.name: commenceDPIProcess
operations.description: Commences the DPI process with the correct messaging to Network Operations, if implemented (M1).

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes (M1).

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The system Network Operations uses to monitor the progress of a flight within 3hrs flying time of destination.

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight and provides updates enabling a Flight Update Message to be sent (M3).

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft reporting system (ACARS-equipped aircraft) that provides ON/OFF/IN/OUT signals for landing, in-block, off-block and take-off events.

operations.name: reportEvent
operations.description: Reports the actual time of a flight event (ALDT/ACARS=ON, AIBT/ACARS=IN, AOBT/ACARS=OUT, ATOT/ACARS=OFF) with an accuracy of +/-1 minute.

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC/airport detection systems (radar, A-SMGCS, automated docking systems, Tower FDPS) that detect and provide actual times for a flight.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy of detection, stated to be equal to the accuracy of the ATC system.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects a flight based on the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or predetermined level (M4, M5).

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) sent to Network Operations with updated flight time estimates.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of DPI message sent, as named in the milestone procedures.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time the message was sent.

classes.name: FUMMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations providing updates of a flight's progress.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time the FUM was sent.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: A Ready Status (RDY) message confirming that the flight follows the indicated TOBT.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time the ready status was recorded.

classes.name: FSAMessage
classes.definition: An FSA message sent upon take off.

classes.name: MVTMessage
classes.definition: An MVT message sent upon take off.

classes.name: AirborneMessage
classes.definition: The airborne message generated at take off, after which the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

attributes.name: generatedAt
attributes.description: The time the airborne message was generated.

M11: The distinction between physically boarding and being pre-called to the gate via flight information display systems (FIDS) or public address systems is a clarification, not a separate trackable milestone event.
M12: The parenthetical roles '(Dispatcher / Supervisor / Redcap)' identifying who at the Ground Handler coordinates with the pilot are not further specified.
M14: The document mentions that a start-up request may be made by 'voice or DCL' (Data Link Clearance) without further defining DCL as a system or message.
